title: Averaged neighbor function
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, and assign to each vertex a function from the $q$-dimensional Boolean cube to the signs. For a vertex $v$, its averaged neighbor function sends each query $x$ to the uniform average, over neighbors $w$ of $v$, of the real value of the sign returned by $w$'s function at the query permuted according to the constraint on $(v,w)$. This function takes values in $[-1,1]$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game G with alphabet size q
A Boolean sign-valued function at each vertex
